correctedCritiques.con-first-cause-parity: Strongest feature: The reply precisely distinguishes a cosmological beginning from creation out of nothing and identifies the explanatory asymmetry when God, unlike reality itself, receives exemption from causal requirements. Principal limitation: It develops causal parity more completely than the fine-tuning consideration and leaves unresolved whether a necessary creator and an uncreated physical universe have comparable explanatory characteristics. Live burden: The secular case must extend logical possibility into explanation by identifying a natural cosmology and showing why the necessary-being distinction either fails or contributes no explanatory advantage. Locked score: The very strong band reflects scope, restrained possibility language, direct engagement with a creator inference, and charitable recognition of the theistic distinction, alongside bounded incompleteness about fine-tuning and constructive cosmology.
correctedCritiques.con-evolution-explains-design: Strongest feature: The move provides an evidenced mechanism for complexity, reinforces it through fossil and genetic considerations, and directly explains why apparent organic design does not independently require divine craftsmanship. Principal limitation: The biological explanation does not resolve cosmic fine-tuning, the origin of natural laws, or the possibility that a deity operates through evolution, so its argumentative reach remains delimited. Live burden: The case must distinguish defeating a biological design inference from disproving theism, while explaining why compatibility with divine guidance contributes no predictive or explanatory evidence. Locked score: The very strong band reflects empirical warrant, biological scope, responsiveness, terminology, and treatment of compatibility, subject only to the limitation that adjacent cosmological design questions remain beyond this move.
